label: early t in the sequence: late-input/delimiter trace, and copy steps that output t
explanation: Fires on sequences that contain the letter t. It has two modes. (1) Input/delimiter phase: once a t has appeared among the first ~3 original tokens, the feature turns on about 2-3 steps later and stays on until <DEL>. Activation grows with distance from the t: the strongest cases (0.8-1.0 of max) are sequences that start t t t, and the feature peaks a few steps after the t and at <DEL>. A t that appears late in the input (position 4 or later) gives little or nothing during input. (2) Copy phase: weaker activation on the steps whose output is t or whose next output is t, and it fades over the copy steps that follow. It never fires at t=0 or 1, and it does not respond to the t token itself as an input. When the sequence has no t, it fires only weakly and sparsely, which accounts for most of the low-quartile misses. first_tok==t carries about 50% of the activation mass. Dev F1 is 0.62 with mass recall 0.87; precision is limited because many predicted steps (late t, long gaps) stay at zero.
